name: DepthAI Core
summary: C++ core library and Python bindings for Luxonis OAK cameras: on-device stereo depth, neural inference and feature tracking pipelines.
why_it_matters: OAK cameras give a small UAS or UGV onboard stereo depth and feature tracking without a GPU, a cheap input for VIO and obstacle avoidance when GNSS is gone.
hackathon_notes: The luxonis/depthai repo is a placeholder; real code and examples live here. Needs OAK hardware.
